issues.description: The core DP update is incorrect: dp[A] is set to dp[B] instead of to the valid departure_time when arrival_time <= dp[B]. This produces wrong answers (e.g., the provided sample).
Algorithmic complexity is O(N * M) due to N outer iterations over all M train infos; this will TLE for N, M up to 2e5 and is not scalable.

Uses float('inf') / -float('inf') sentinels mixed with integer time arithmetic. This can cause precision issues and unexpected behavior for very large integer times; dp should use integers or handle sentinels explicitly.
The observed failing sample from the task description was not eliminated by this correction (acceptance criterion CA-02 not satisfied).
No tests are included. Add the provided sample tests and additional edge/performance tests to validate correctness and scalability.
